sampling.mab: 30 questions sampled uniformly without replacement from each of all five eventqa_65536 contexts
sampling.halu: 25 questions per six question types; seeded round robin across users, using only sessions 0 through 29 and their cumulative real dialogue histories

pseudonymization: spaCy en_core_web_sm 3.8.0 PERSON candidate words, filtered to non-stopwords capitalized in at least 80% of occurrences, mapped to compact PersonNNN aliases in word-hash order before indexing and inference
